# NeuroNetworks AI Ed

> Practical AI and technology education in India. One-year AI Foundation course (104 hours, open from Class 8) and five three-year specialisations for students who have passed Class 10 (624 hours each). Every three-year month ends with a project and a one-hour exam. Fees are shared on enquiry.

Contact: Hussain@neuronetwrks.com

## Programs
- [AI Foundation](https://neuronetwrks.com/programs/ai-foundation): 1 year, 104 hours. A beginner course from AI literacy to Python, data, machine learning, generative AI, RAG and AI agents, ending with a deployed AI application and a capstone.
- [AI/ML Engineering](https://neuronetwrks.com/programs/ai-ml-engineering): 3 years, 624 hours. From Python basics to machine learning, deep learning, generative AI and MLOps, with a portfolio of projects.
- [Software Development](https://neuronetwrks.com/programs/software-development): 3 years, 624 hours. From programming logic to full-stack, cloud and software engineering, with a high volume of hands-on projects.
- [Data Science & AI](https://neuronetwrks.com/programs/data-science-ai): 3 years, 624 hours. From Python and SQL to analytics, machine learning, data engineering and generative AI, with a project portfolio.
- [Product & UX / AI Design](https://neuronetwrks.com/programs/product-ux-ai-design): 3 years, 624 hours. From visual and UX fundamentals to product thinking, AI-assisted design, prototyping and a professional portfolio.
- [Cybersecurity](https://neuronetwrks.com/programs/cybersecurity): 3 years, 624 hours. From computer and networking basics to security operations and ethical hacking, practised in authorised labs.

## Notes
- No program guarantees a job, internship or salary.
- Certifications are awarded by the certifying organisations, not by NeuroNetworks AI Ed.

## Guides
- [AI courses after 10th: eligibility, duration, projects](https://neuronetwrks.com/guides/ai-courses-after-10th): What an AI course after Class 10 covers, how many hours it takes, what students build, and how to choose between a 1-year and a 3-year path.
- [Courses after 10th: 6 technology paths compared](https://neuronetwrks.com/guides/courses-after-10th): Compare six technology courses after Class 10: AI, AI/ML, coding, data science, UI/UX design and cyber security, by hours, skills and projects.
- [Computer and coding courses after 10th: which to choose](https://neuronetwrks.com/guides/computer-coding-courses-after-10th): What a coding course after Class 10 teaches: Java, JavaScript, React, databases and cloud over 3 years and 624 hours, with a project every month.
- [Cyber security course after 10th: what you study](https://neuronetwrks.com/guides/cyber-security-course-after-10th): A cyber security course after Class 10, explained: networking, Linux, SOC work, ethical hacking in authorised labs, cloud security and 6 certifications.
- [Data science course after 10th: is it possible?](https://neuronetwrks.com/guides/data-science-after-10th): A data science course after Class 10, explained: Python, SQL, statistics, dashboards, machine learning and generative AI over 3 years and 624 hours.
- [How to become a UI/UX designer after 10th](https://neuronetwrks.com/guides/ui-ux-designer-after-10th): A UI/UX design course after Class 10: user research, wireframes, prototypes, design systems and AI product design over 3 years and 624 hours.
- [AI vs software vs data science: a parent's guide](https://neuronetwrks.com/guides/ai-vs-software-vs-data-science): Help your child choose between AI/ML engineering, software development and data science after Class 10: what each teaches, tools, projects and pace.
- [AI projects for students: from classifier to AI agent](https://neuronetwrks.com/guides/ai-projects-for-students): Real AI projects students build in the AI/ML Engineering program: an image classifier, a document RAG assistant and AgentFlow AI, a tool-using agent.
- [Career options after 10th in AI and technology](https://neuronetwrks.com/guides/career-options-after-10th): Confused about career options after 10th? A clear map of AI, software, data, design and cyber security paths, the skills each needs and how to start.
- [How to become an AI engineer after 10th: step by step](https://neuronetwrks.com/guides/become-ai-engineer-after-10th): A step-by-step path to becoming an AI engineer after Class 10: Python, maths for ML, machine learning, deep learning, generative AI, MLOps and a portfolio.
